title: Visual CIDR & Subnet Overlap Matrix Specification
description: Formal specification for parsing IPv4/IPv6 CIDR blocks, detecting overlaps and collisions, computing 2D spatial tree partitions, and recommending available subnets.

ERR_INVALID_CIDR.title: Invalid CIDR Format
ERR_INVALID_CIDR.description: Provided string is not a valid IPv4 or IPv6 CIDR notation (e.g. 10.0.0.0/16 or 2001:db8::/32).

ERR_OVERLAP_COLLISION.title: Subnet Overlap Collision
ERR_OVERLAP_COLLISION.description: Two or more subnets overlap with shared IP addresses in the same address space.

ERR_SUBNET_EXHAUSTED.title: Subnet Space Exhausted
ERR_SUBNET_EXHAUSTED.description: No contiguous free subnet of the requested prefix length could be found inside the parent address range.

WARN_CONTAINMENT.title: Parent-Child Containment
WARN_CONTAINMENT.description: One CIDR block completely encompasses another smaller CIDR block.

WARN_NON_CANONICAL_IP.title: Host Bits Set in Network Address
WARN_NON_CANONICAL_IP.description: The specified IP address contains non-zero host bits for the mask (e.g., 10.0.0.5/24 automatically normalized to 10.0.0.0/24).

INFO_FREE_ALLOCATION_FOUND.title: Free Allocation Available
INFO_FREE_ALLOCATION_FOUND.description: An available non-overlapping block matching the requested prefix length was successfully calculated.
